description: Unified Cross-Regional Time-Series Day-Ahead Electricity Price Dataset (UniElecPrice) is a data set described in the paper "Unified Cross-Regional Time-Series Day-Ahead Electricity Price Dataset (UniElecPrice)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2025), produced by Md Habib Ullah, Sayed Mohsin Reza, Lasya Madhuri Gundapaneni and colleagues. Electricity price forecasting informs decision-making in day-ahead (DA) electricity markets, which has drawn significant attention in the research community with the advancement of artificial intelligence over the past years. In such research, access to diverse and high-quality datasets are used to evaluate the performance of forecasting models effectively under the influence of data from a wide range of markets. Coverage: several day-ahead electricity markets. The data are held on IEEE DataPort, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity price forecasting and market studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
